title: Supplemental Japanese verb sense sample development bank

provenance.sentence_provenance: All Japanese sentences were written for this draft. No dictionary examples, corpus rows, or external sentence text were copied.
provenance.reference_provenance: Taiwan Traditional Chinese references were drafted independently for this development bank; they are provisional pending review.

purpose: Provide public development contrasts for six fixed Japanese verbs and distinguish common senses by explicit subjects, objects, destinations, and recurrence cues.
level_note: Approximate sentence difficulty only. This is not an exam or JLPT certification. Some target verbs may be above beginner vocabulary level.

review_and_adoption.process: Independent language review and adoption must be recorded in a separate data-only PR before any rule uses these rows for acceptance.
review_and_adoption.scope_limit: These rows sample only the listed sense contrasts. They do not define all uses of the six verbs.

items.jp: 彼は友だちの冗談にすぐ突っ込んだ。
items.zh_hant: 他立刻吐槽朋友的玩笑。
semantic_checks: The friend’s joke and quick reply frame a spoken response; humorous or comedic intent is contextual support, not a required fact.
The main verb uses the verbal retort sense of 突っ込む.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state whether the friend laughs or how the joke is received.

control.source_cue: The friend’s joke and quick reply frame a spoken response; humorous or comedic intent is contextual support, not a required fact.
stable: Each row is an original, standalone sentence with one primary event.
changed: This row tests verbal retort for 突っ込む.
limits: The source does not state whether the friend laughs or how the joke is received.
